name: p_mem_k2
formula: Layers [14, 16, 18, 20, 22]: rewrite the quietest MLP neuron as a romance detector: gate = alpha (r - theta c), up = c, down = beta v. r = ridge-LDA romance direction on MLP inputs (pass 3 fit halves); c = stable bias feature (c . mean x = 1); theta at fraction 0.5 from negatives' mean to the forget median; alpha = 6.0 / (median - theta); beta = 2.0 * typical MLP output norm / 6.0; v = unit(d / (1 + w_postff)), d = memory direction at the layer output.
